-- Key factorial identity: (k+1)! - 1 + (k+1)*(k+1)! = (k+2)! - 1

lemma finset_range_succ_split (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (i + 1) * Nat.factorial (i + 1) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (i + 1) * Nat.factorial (i + 1) + (n + 1) * Nat.factorial (n + 1) := by exact?

-- Fact: (n+1)! ≥ 1 for all n (needed for subtraction safety)

lemma factorial_ge_one (n : ℕ) : Nat.factorial (n + 1) ≥ 1 := by induction n with
| zero => simp [Nat.factorial_succ]
| succ n ih =>
    rw [Nat.factorial_succ]
    apply Nat.succ_le_of_lt
    exact mul_pos (Nat.succ_pos _) (Nat.factorial_pos _)

-- Helper: show RHS of theorem is well-defined (non-negative after subtraction)

lemma factorial_sub_bound (n : ℕ) : Nat.factorial (n + 1) - 1 ≤ Nat.factorial (n + 1) := by norm_num
